title: Viva Glint: choose whether to retain or erase survey data for deleted users
summary: Hold: the briefing extends the control to deletions in HR systems without documentation establishing that connection. The documented routes are manual deletion in Glint and Microsoft Entra delete signals; the control paths, retention values and roadmap details otherwise check out.

claims.claim: Viva Glint has a control that chooses retention or erasure of deleted users' survey and identifiable data.
claims.quote: Viva Glint Admins, as data controllers, can choose to either: retain all survey responses and identifiable data for deleted users, including first and last name, email address and employee ID, or erase all data related to the requester, including survey responses.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes the control as covering users manually deleted from Glint.
claims.quote: for users who are manually deleted from Glint or deleted via the signals received via Microsoft Entra.
